intent: Preserve the File Tidy folder/document/checkmark identity; correct only the macOS app silhouette and optical size.
generation_prompt: Edit the supplied File Tidy icon into a standalone macOS Dock icon. Preserve the mint folder, yellow document and yellow checkmark badge, dark outlines and original composition. Center the warm ivory tile as a smooth rounded square with generous actual transparent margin on all sides; reduce the optical size. No text, arrows, new symbols, mockup or surrounding Dock.
cleanup_prompt: Keep the inner artwork unchanged. Remove stray pixels and ragged fragments outside the rounded tile, retain a smooth antialiased rounded contour and actual RGBA transparency. Keep generous transparent margins; do not enlarge the tile.
export: Normalize square PNG to 1024x1024 with sips; generate native ICNS resolutions using scripts/build-macos-icon.mjs.
